user.title: Adaptive Volume
user.description: One instance per speaker group, each with its own schedule.

data_description.name: e.g. Living room
data_description.players: Media players this instance looks after.

data_description.mode: Smooth curve: the volume glides between points. Steps: each point's volume holds until the next.
data_description.points:
One point per line: a time and a volume. Times can be a clock time or sunrise/sunset with an offset in minutes, e.g.
07:00 20
sunrise+30 25
sunset-45 30
22:00 15
data_description.idle_gap: Minutes a speaker must be not playing before its next play counts as a fresh start and gets the schedule's volume. Shorter pauses keep your volume.
data_description.skip_sources: Comma-separated sources where Adaptive Volume never touches the volume, e.g. Line In.
data_description.quiet_volume: Volume while quiet is on (the Quiet switch, or the linked entity). Also the maximum while quiet.
data_description.quiet_entity: Optional: quiet turns on by itself while this entity is in the state below (e.g. a night-mode switch, or an input_select).
data_description.quiet_state: The state that means quiet (default on).
data_description.cap_enabled: During cap hours, turning a speaker above the cap volume pulls it straight back to the cap.
data_description.cap_volume: The maximum during cap hours. Fresh starts never go above it either.
